## TRA Timeline

#### JV formation and TRA execution

- 2018-01-01: Transaction with International Paper closes; TRA executed under joint 8-K co-filed by Graphic Packaging Holding Company and this firm; Graphic Packaging International, LLC is not itself a contractual party but is the operating LLC whose assets generate the basis-step-up attributes

#### IP exit transactions (TRA-touching consents, not amendments)

- 2020-01-23: First IP redemption; Consent and Waiver Agreement co-filed
- 2020-08-06: Second IP redemption; Consent and Waiver Agreement co-filed
- 2021-02-19: IP exchange; $43M TRA liability recorded at the parent
- 2021-05-21: IP final sale to GPI Holding I, Inc.; $66M TRA liability recorded at the parent; IP exits GPIP

## Explanation

Graphic Packaging International, LLC is the principal operating subsidiary and senior-notes registrant within the Graphic Packaging consolidated group; it is not itself a contractual party to the January 1, 2018 Tax Receivable Agreement but appears here because the originating 8-K (and several subsequent IP-exit 8-Ks) are joint co-filings with the public parent. The TRA itself obligates the Consolidated Group to pay 50% of net realized tax benefits to International Paper on Section 754 basis step-ups from IP's Exchanges of GPIP Common Units. See the parent's record at `../graphic-packaging-holding-co_0001408075/graphic-packaging-holding-co_summary.qmd` for the full explanation, the IP staged-exit narrative, and the $109M of cumulative cash payments through 2021. See `contract_log.md` for the filing-by-filing record at this CIK.
